title: Markdown
description: An answer's text, set as it arrives: headings, paragraphs, nested lists, quotes, tables, inline code and safe links, with every fence in a Code block. While it streams a green caret follows the last word, a half-arrived mark is closed, and a pace reveals what has arrived a word at a time.
